"""Complete normalization and unchanged first-thread consumers on resident inputs."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from common import digest, load_consumer, provenance

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=["baseline", "patch"], required=True)
parser.add_argument("--build", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--rows", type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--correctness-only", action="store_true")
args = parser.parse_args()
torch.set_num_threads(8)
torch.manual_seed(11504)
consumer = load_consumer(args.build, args.variant)
record = provenance(args.source, consumer) | {
    "variant": args.variant,
    "rows": args.rows,
    "cases": [],
}
correctness = []
for columns in [1, 7, 31, 33, 65, 127, 129, 257, 511, 513, 543]:
    for masked in [False, True]:
        input = torch.randn(19, columns, device="cuda") * 4
        if masked:
            valid = torch.arange(19, device="cuda") % columns + 1
            input = input.masked_fill(
                torch.arange(columns, device="cuda")[None] >= valid[:, None], -torch.inf
            )
        output = consumer.normalize(input, False, args.variant == "patch")
        expected = input.double().softmax(dim=-1).float()
        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-7)
        correctness.append(
            {
                "columns": columns,
                "masked": masked,
                "max_abs_error": (output - expected).abs().max().item(),
                "output_sha256": digest(output),
            }
        )
record["correctness"] = correctness
cases = []
for columns in ([] if args.correctness_only else [32, 128, 256, 512]):
    input = torch.rand(args.rows, columns, device="cuda") * 8 - 4
    reference = input.double().softmax(dim=-1).float()
    for first_thread in [False, True]:
        if first_thread:
            # Dyadic inputs make every FP32 intermediate sum exactly representable.
            input = (
                torch.randint(-64, 65, (args.rows, columns), device="cuda").float() / 16
            )
        output = consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        expected = (
            torch.stack(
                [input.double().sum(dim=-1).float(), input.max(dim=-1).values], dim=-1
            )
            if first_thread
            else reference
        )
        error = (output - expected).abs().max().item()
        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-6)
        output_hash = digest(output)
        warm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
        warm_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
        with torch.cuda.stream(warm_stream):
            for _ in range(5):
                consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(warm_stream)
        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
            captured = consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        for _ in range(5):
            graph.replay()
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        torch.testing.assert_close(captured, output, rtol=0, atol=0)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(20):
            start, end = (
                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
            )
            start.record()
            for _ in range(100):
                graph.replay()
            end.record()
            end.synchronize()
            samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 10)
        cases.append(
            {
                "kind": "first-thread" if first_thread else "normalization",
                "columns": columns,
                "max_abs_error": error,
                "input_sha256": digest(input),
                "output_sha256": output_hash,
                "input_address": input.data_ptr(),
                "output_address": captured.data_ptr(),
                "samples_us": samples,
            }
        )
        graph.reset()
record["cases"] = cases
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)

"""Build the identical downstream consumer against selected CCCL headers."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=["baseline", "patch"], required=True)
parser.add_argument("--build", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
args.build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
harness = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source = args.source.resolve()
extension = load(
    name=f"cccl_{args.variant}_h20",
    sources=[str(harness / "bindings.cpp"), str(harness / "normalization.cu")],
    extra_include_paths=[
        str(source / name) for name in ["cub", "libcudacxx/include", "thrust"]
    ],
    extra_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"],
    extra_cuda_cflags=[
        "-O3",
        "-lineinfo",
        "-std=c++17",
        f"-DUSE_BROADCAST={int(args.variant == 'patch')}",
        "-gencode=arch=compute_90,code=sm_90",
    ],
    build_directory=str(args.build.resolve()),
    verbose=True,
)
library = Path(extension.__file__)
files = [
    source / "cub/cub/block/block_reduce.cuh",
    source / "cub/cub/block/specializations/block_reduce_warp_reductions.cuh",
    harness / "bindings.cpp",
    harness / "normalization.cu",
    library,
    args.build / "build.ninja",
]
record = {
    "variant": args.variant,
    "torch": torch.__version__,
    "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
    "source_sha": subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(source), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True
    ).strip(),
    "source_diff_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(source), "diff", "HEAD"])
    ).hexdigest(),
    "files": [
        {
            "path": str(path),
            "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        }
        for path in files
    ],
    "library": str(library),
}
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)

"""Complete integer-histogram normalization and unchanged first-thread controls."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from common import digest, load_consumer, provenance

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--variant", choices=["baseline", "patch"], required=True)
parser.add_argument("--build", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--rows", type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--correctness-only", action="store_true")
args = parser.parse_args()
torch.set_num_threads(8)
torch.manual_seed(11504)
consumer = load_consumer(args.build, args.variant)
record = provenance(args.source, consumer) | {
    "variant": args.variant,
    "rows": args.rows,
    "cases": [],
}
correctness = []
for columns in [1, 7, 31, 33, 65, 127, 129, 257, 511, 513, 543]:
    for masked in [False, True]:
        input = torch.randint(1, 1025, (19, columns), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
        if masked:
            valid = torch.arange(19, device="cuda") % columns + 1
            input = input.masked_fill(
                torch.arange(columns, device="cuda")[None] >= valid[:, None], 0
            )
        output = consumer.normalize(input, False, args.variant == "patch")
        expected = (input.double() / input.double().sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)).float()
        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=2e-6, atol=2e-7)
        correctness.append(
            {
                "columns": columns,
                "masked": masked,
                "max_abs_error": (output - expected).abs().max().item(),
                "output_sha256": digest(output),
            }
        )
record["correctness"] = correctness
cases = []
for columns in [] if args.correctness_only else [32, 128, 256, 512]:
    input = torch.randint(
        1, 1025, (args.rows, columns), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
    )
    reference = (input.double() / input.double().sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)).float()
    for first_thread in [False, True]:
        if first_thread:
            input = torch.randint(
                -64, 65, (args.rows, columns), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
            )
        output = consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        expected = (
            torch.stack(
                [input.sum(dim=-1).to(torch.int32), input.max(dim=-1).values], dim=-1
            )
            if first_thread
            else reference
        )
        error = (output - expected).abs().max().item()
        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-6)
        output_hash = digest(output)
        warm_stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
        warm_stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
        with torch.cuda.stream(warm_stream):
            for _ in range(5):
                consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(warm_stream)
        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
            captured = consumer.normalize(input, first_thread, args.variant == "patch")
        for _ in range(5):
            graph.replay()
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        torch.testing.assert_close(captured, output, rtol=0, atol=0)
        samples = []
        for _ in range(20):
            start, end = (
                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
                torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True),
            )
            start.record()
            for _ in range(100):
                graph.replay()
            end.record()
            end.synchronize()
            samples.append(start.elapsed_time(end) * 10)
        cases.append(
            {
                "kind": "first-thread" if first_thread else "normalization",
                "columns": columns,
                "max_abs_error": error,
                "input_sha256": digest(input),
                "output_sha256": output_hash,
                "input_address": input.data_ptr(),
                "output_address": captured.data_ptr(),
                "samples_us": samples,
            }
        )
        graph.reset()
record["cases"] = cases
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)

"""Locate native versus consumer differences before candidate model timing."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.models.qwen3 import modeling_qwen3

root = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/cccl-reduce-broadcast-h20")
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "tools/consumer_retained"))
from common import digest, load_consumer, provenance

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--consumer-mode", choices=["legacy", "retained"], required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
consumer = load_consumer(root / f"build/formal-{args.consumer_mode}-A", "baseline")
native = modeling_qwen3.eager_attention_forward
active = "N"


def attention(
    module, query, key, value, attention_mask, scaling, dropout=0.0, **kwargs
):
    assert dropout == 0 and not module.training
    if active == "N":
        return native(
            module, query, key, value, attention_mask, scaling, dropout, **kwargs
        )
    key = modeling_qwen3.repeat_kv(key, module.num_key_value_groups)
    value = modeling_qwen3.repeat_kv(value, module.num_key_value_groups)
    scores = torch.matmul(query, key.transpose(2, 3)) * scaling
    if attention_mask is not None:
        scores = scores + attention_mask[:, :, :, : key.shape[-2]]
    probabilities = (
        scores.softmax(dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32)
        if active == "T"
        else (
            scores.double().softmax(dim=-1)
            if active == "G"
            else consumer.normalize(scores.float().contiguous(), False, False)
        )
    )
    probabilities = probabilities.to(query.dtype)
    return torch.matmul(probabilities, value).transpose(
        1, 2
    ).contiguous(), probabilities


modeling_qwen3.eager_attention_forward = attention
torch.set_num_threads(8)
torch.manual_seed(11504)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
checkpoint = root / "models/iteration-qwen3"
model = (
    AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        checkpoint,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        attn_implementation="eager",
        local_files_only=True,
    )
    .eval()
    .cuda()
)
assert model.config.num_hidden_layers == 28
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True)
prompt = tokenizer.encode(
    "Explain how a deterministic parallel reduction combines values. ",
    add_special_tokens=False,
)
records = []
with torch.inference_mode():
    for length in [128, 512]:
        ids = torch.tensor(
            (prompt * (length // len(prompt) + 1))[:length], device="cuda"
        ).unsqueeze(0)
        outputs = {}
        logits = {}
        for active in ["N", "T", "A", "G"]:
            tokens = model.generate(
                ids,
                min_new_tokens=32,
                max_new_tokens=32,
                do_sample=False,
                pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
            )[:, -32:]
            outputs[active] = tokens
            current, cache = ids, None
            steps = []
            for step in range(32):
                output = model(
                    current, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1
                )
                steps.append(output.logits[:, -1].clone())
                cache = output.past_key_values
                current = outputs["N"][:, step : step + 1]
            logits[active] = torch.cat(steps).float()
        row = {"input_tokens": length, "input_sha256": digest(ids), "arms": {}}
        eos_ids = model.generation_config.eos_token_id
        eos_ids = [eos_ids] if isinstance(eos_ids, int) else eos_ids
        ranking = {arm: value.clone() for arm, value in logits.items()}
        for value in ranking.values():
            value[:, eos_ids] = -torch.inf
        for arm, tokens in outputs.items():
            differences = torch.nonzero(tokens != outputs["N"])
            error = (logits[arm] - logits["G"]).abs()
            prediction_diff = torch.nonzero(
                ranking[arm].argmax(-1) != ranking["N"].argmax(-1)
            ).flatten()
            first = int(prediction_diff[0]) if prediction_diff.numel() else None
            top = ranking["N"][first].topk(2) if first is not None else None
            row["arms"][arm] = {
                "tokens": tokens.cpu().tolist(),
                "tokens_exact_to_native": torch.equal(tokens, outputs["N"]),
                "first_greedy_difference": differences[0].cpu().tolist()
                if differences.numel()
                else None,
                "teacher_forced_logits_sha256": digest(logits[arm]),
                "logits_exact_to_native": torch.equal(logits[arm], logits["N"]),
                "gold_max_error": error.max().item(),
                "gold_mean_error": error.mean().item(),
                "first_teacher_forced_top1_difference": first,
                "generation_eos_exclusion": eos_ids,
                "native_top2": {
                    "ids": top.indices.cpu().tolist(),
                    "logits": top.values.cpu().tolist(),
                    "consumer_logits": logits[arm][first, top.indices].cpu().tolist(),
                }
                if top is not None
                else None,
            }
        records.append(row)
        args.output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "consumer_mode": args.consumer_mode,
                    "harness_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        Path(__file__).read_bytes()
                    ).hexdigest(),
                    "native_source": str(Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__).resolve()),
                    "native_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__).read_bytes()
                    ).hexdigest(),
                    **provenance(root / "baseline", consumer),
                    "cases": records,
                },
                indent=2,
            )
            + "\n"
        )
        print(
            length,
            {arm: row["arms"][arm]["first_greedy_difference"] for arm in outputs},
            flush=True,
        )

"""One resident checkpoint; fresh KV state for each audited normalization arm."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.models.qwen3 import modeling_qwen3
from transformers.models.qwen3.modeling_qwen3 import Qwen3Attention

root = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/cccl-reduce-broadcast-h20")
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "patch/cub/test/validation_block_reduce_broadcast"))
from common import digest, load_consumer, provenance

native_attention = modeling_qwen3.eager_attention_forward

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument(
    "--candidate",
    choices=[
        "patch",
        "smallwarp",
        "fullmask",
        "volatile",
        "tree",
        "tree-leader",
        "tree-publish",
        "ordered-shuffle",
        "hybrid",
        "hybrid-v2",
    ],
    required=True,
)
parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, choices=[1, 16], default=1)
parser.add_argument("--consumer-mode", choices=["legacy", "retained"], default="legacy")
parser.add_argument("--arm", choices=["A", "P"])
parser.add_argument("--independent-build", action="store_true")
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
torch.set_num_threads(8)
torch.manual_seed(11504)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
build_prefix = "consumer-retained" if args.consumer_mode == "retained" else "consumer"
consumers = {
    "A": load_consumer(
        root
        / (
            f"build/formal-{args.consumer_mode}-A"
            if args.independent_build
            else f"build/{build_prefix}-baseline"
        ),
        "baseline",
    ),
    "P": load_consumer(
        root
        / (
            f"build/formal-{args.consumer_mode}-P"
            if args.independent_build
            else f"build/{build_prefix}-{args.candidate}"
        ),
        "patch",
    ),
}
sources = {
    "A": root / "baseline",
    "P": root
    / ("patch" if args.candidate == "patch" else f"iteration-{args.candidate}"),
}
active = "A"
calls = [0] * 28
shapes: Counter[tuple[int, int]] = Counter()


def attention(
    module: Qwen3Attention,
    query: torch.Tensor,
    key: torch.Tensor,
    value: torch.Tensor,
    attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
    scaling: float,
    dropout: float = 0.0,
    **unused: object,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    assert dropout == 0 and not module.training
    if active == "N":
        calls[module.layer_idx] += 1
        shapes[(query.shape[0] * query.shape[1] * query.shape[2], key.shape[-2])] += 1
        return native_attention(
            module, query, key, value, attention_mask, scaling, dropout, **unused
        )
    key = modeling_qwen3.repeat_kv(key, module.num_key_value_groups)
    value = modeling_qwen3.repeat_kv(value, module.num_key_value_groups)
    scores = torch.matmul(query, key.transpose(2, 3)) * scaling
    if attention_mask is not None:
        scores = scores + attention_mask[:, :, :, : key.shape[-2]]
    scores = scores.float().contiguous()
    probabilities = (
        scores.double().softmax(dim=-1)
        if active == "G"
        else consumers[active].normalize(scores, False, active == "P")
    ).to(query.dtype)
    calls[module.layer_idx] += 1
    shapes[(scores.numel() // scores.shape[-1], scores.shape[-1])] += 1
    return torch.matmul(probabilities, value).transpose(
        1, 2
    ).contiguous(), probabilities


modeling_qwen3.eager_attention_forward = attention
checkpoint = root / "models/iteration-qwen3"
model = (
    AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        checkpoint,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        attn_implementation="eager",
        local_files_only=True,
    )
    .eval()
    .cuda()
)
assert model.config.num_hidden_layers == 28
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint, local_files_only=True)
prompt = tokenizer.encode(
    "Explain how a deterministic parallel reduction combines values. ",
    add_special_tokens=False,
)
addresses = [parameter.data_ptr() for parameter in model.parameters()]
weight_versions = [parameter._version for parameter in model.parameters()]
records = []
reference = {}
native_results = []


@torch.inference_mode()
def teacher_force(input_ids: torch.Tensor, forced: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    current, cache = input_ids, None
    logits = []
    for step in range(32):
        output = model(current, past_key_values=cache, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1)
        logits.append(output.logits[:, -1].clone())
        current = forced[:, step : step + 1]
        cache = output.past_key_values
    return torch.cat(logits).float()


@torch.inference_mode()
def generate(input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    return model.generate(
        input_ids,
        min_new_tokens=32,
        max_new_tokens=32,
        do_sample=False,
        use_cache=True,
        pad_token_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id,
    )[:, -32:]


for length in [128, 512]:
    ids = torch.tensor(
        (prompt * (length // len(prompt) + 1))[:length], device="cuda"
    ).unsqueeze(0)
    ids = ids.expand(args.batch_size, -1).clone()
    active = "N"
    native_tokens = generate(ids)
    native_logits = teacher_force(ids, native_tokens)
    for _ in range(2 if args.arm is None else 0):
        generate(ids)
    native_samples = []
    for _ in range(5 if args.arm is None else 0):
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        started = time.perf_counter()
        generated = generate(ids)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        native_samples.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
        assert torch.equal(generated, native_tokens)
    native_results.append(
        {
            "input_tokens": length,
            "samples_ms": native_samples,
            "tokens_sha256": digest(native_tokens),
        }
    )
    active = "A"
    tokens = generate(ids)
    assert torch.equal(tokens, native_tokens)
    a_logits = teacher_force(ids, tokens)
    active = "G"
    gold = teacher_force(ids, tokens)
    native_error = (native_logits - gold).abs()
    native_results[-1] |= {
        "logits_sha256": digest(native_logits),
        "gold_max_error": native_error.max().item(),
        "gold_mean_error": native_error.mean().item(),
        "logits_exact_to_upstream_cub": torch.equal(native_logits, a_logits),
    }
    error = (a_logits - gold).abs()
    # Freeze the allowance from the independent FP64-normalization reference and A only.
    reference[length] = {
        "tokens": tokens,
        "a_logits": a_logits,
        "gold": gold,
        "max_budget": 2 * error.max().item() + 1e-5,
        "mean_budget": 2 * error.mean().item() + 1e-5,
    }

for block, order in enumerate([args.arm] if args.arm else ["APPA", "PAAP"]):
    for position, active in enumerate(order):
        row = {
            "block": block,
            "order": order,
            "position": position,

        }
        for length in [128, 512]:

            if args.candidate in {"volatile", "hybrid", "hybrid-v2"}:
                assert torch.equal(logits, expected["a_logits"])
            error = (logits - expected["gold"]).abs()
            max_error, mean_error = error.max().item(), error.mean().item()
            assert (

                and mean_error <= expected["mean_budget"]
            )
            for _ in range(2):
                generate(ids)
            calls[:] = [0] * 28
            shapes.clear()
            samples = []
            for _ in range(5):
                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                started = time.perf_counter()
                generated = generate(ids)
                torch.cuda.synchronize()
                samples.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
                assert torch.equal(generated, expected["tokens"])
            assert calls == [160] * 28
            assert addresses == [
                parameter.data_ptr() for parameter in model.parameters()
            ]
            assert weight_versions == [
                parameter._version for parameter in model.parameters()
            ]
            row["cases"].append(
                {
                    "input_tokens": length,
                    "output_tokens": 32,
                    "input_sha256": digest(ids),
                    "samples_ms": samples,
                    "tokens_exact": True,
                    "tokens_sha256": digest(generated),
                    "logits_sha256": digest(logits),
                    "gold_logits_sha256": digest(expected["gold"]),
                    "control_logits_sha256": digest(expected["a_logits"]),
                    "logits_exact_to_control": torch.equal(
                        logits, expected["a_logits"]
                    ),
                    "gold_max_error": max_error,
                    "gold_mean_error": mean_error,
                    "max_budget": expected["max_budget"],
                    "mean_budget": expected["mean_budget"],
                    "calls_per_layer": calls.copy(),
                    "weight_addresses_stable": True,
                    "shapes": [
                        {"rows": r, "columns": c, "calls": n}

                    ],

            )
        records.append(row)
        args.output.write_text(

                    ).hexdigest(),
                    "batch_size": args.batch_size,
                    "checkpoint_manifest": json.loads(

                    ),

                    "native_source": str(Path(modeling_qwen3.__file__).resolve()),
                    "native_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(

                    ).hexdigest(),
                    "native_baseline": native_results,

        print(

"""Reserve an idle H20, run a finite plan, and let every worker exit naturally."""

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

import torch

plan_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
functional = "--functional" in sys.argv[2:]
plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
output = plan_path.with_suffix(".status.json")
uuid = "GPU-8ee84e7d-143f-dd29-1097-85943783e027"


def state():
    apps = subprocess.check_output(
        [
            "nvidia-smi",
            "--query-compute-apps=pid,gpu_uuid,used_memory",
            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
        ],
        text=True,
    )
    gpu = subprocess.check_output(
        [
            "nvidia-smi",
            "--query-gpu=index,uuid,utilization.gpu,memory.used,temperature.gpu,clocks.sm,power.draw",
            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits",
        ],
        text=True,
    )
    parents = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-eo", "pid=,ppid="], text=True)
    return {
        "apps": apps,
        "gpus": gpu,
        "load": os.getloadavg(),
        "process_parents": parents,
    }


def foreign(apps, allowed):
    return [
        line
        for line in apps.splitlines()
        if uuid in line and int(line.split(",")[0]) not in allowed
    ]


def watch(complete, observations, pid):
    while not complete.wait(0.5):
        snapshot = state()
        parents = {
            int(child): int(parent)
            for child, parent in (
                line.split() for line in snapshot["process_parents"].splitlines()
            )
        }
        allowed, pending = {reserve_pid}, {pid}
        while pending:
            allowed.update(pending)
            pending = {
                child
                for child, parent in parents.items()
                if parent in pending and child not in allowed
            }
        observations.append(
            {
                "time": time.time(),
                **snapshot,
                "own_processes": sorted(allowed),
                "foreign_selected_gpu": foreign(snapshot["apps"], allowed),
            }
        )


assert os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] == "1"
reserve_pid = os.getpid()
if not functional:
    before = state()
    while foreign(before["apps"], set()):
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps({"state": "WAITING", "before": before}, indent=2) + "\n"
        )
        time.sleep(10)
        before = state()
    # A constant idle parent context makes the reservation visible to other queues.
    torch.cuda.init()
    reservation = torch.empty(1, device="cuda")
statuses = []
for job in plan:
    before = state()
    row = job | {
        "started": time.time(),
        "before": before,
        "reservation_pid": reserve_pid,
        "observations": [],
    }
    print(job["label"], flush=True)
    with Path(job["log"]).open("w") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            job["command"],
            cwd=job["cwd"],
            env=os.environ
            | {"CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES": "1", "OMP_NUM_THREADS": "8"}
            | job.get("env", {}),
            stdout=log,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        )
        row["pid"] = process.pid
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "state": "RUNNING",
                    "completed": statuses,
                    "current": job["label"],
                    "pid": process.pid,
                },
                indent=2,
            )
            + "\n"
        )
        complete = threading.Event()

        watcher = threading.Thread(
            target=watch, args=(complete, row["observations"], process.pid)
        )
        watcher.start()
        code = process.wait()
        complete.set()
        watcher.join()
    row |= {
        "exit_code": code,
        "elapsed_s": time.time() - row["started"],
        "after": state(),
    }
    statuses.append(row)
    output.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {"state": "RUNNING" if code == 0 else "FAILED", "completed": statuses},
            indent=2,
        )
        + "\n"
    )
    assert code == 0, (job["label"], code)
output.write_text(
    json.dumps({"state": "FINISHED", "completed": statuses}, indent=2) + "\n"
)
print("Every worker finished naturally.", flush=True)

"""Check every unchanged default kernel in a candidate consumer library."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--baseline", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--candidate", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()


def kernels(library: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    dump = subprocess.check_output(
        ["/usr/local/cuda-12.8/bin/cuobjdump", "--dump-sass", str(library)], text=True
    )
    return {
        part.split("\n", 1)[0].strip(): "\n".join(
            line.strip() for line in part.split("\n", 1)[1].splitlines() if "/*" in line
        )
        for part in dump.split("Function : ")[1:]
    }


baseline, candidate = kernels(args.baseline), kernels(args.candidate)
default = [name for name in baseline if "Lb0E" in name or "first_thread" in name]
assert len(default) >= 8
assert all(baseline[name] == candidate[name] for name in default)
record = {
    "baseline_library": str(args.baseline),
    "candidate_library": str(args.candidate),
    "baseline_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.baseline.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "candidate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(args.candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "default_kernels": [
        {
            "name": name,
            "exact": True,
            "sass_sha256": hashlib.sha256(baseline[name].encode()).hexdigest(),
        }
        for name in default
    ],
}
args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
print(
    f"All {len(default)} default kernels have identical CUDA instructions and encodings."
)
